blocks.text: In 1921, Epifanio de los Santos (the historian, not the traffic-choked avenue that bears his name) delivered a lecture mapping out the local fishing industry of his time. He listed scores of native species I do not recognize a century later: buteteng-saguing, biang-itim, biang-puti, and bunog. Mind you, those are just the ones beginning with […]...
